# roadcrashVIC

`roadcrashVIC` is an R package and Shiny app for exploring road crashes
in Victoria, Australia, from 2012 to 2025: how they have changed over
time, where and when they happen, and who is involved.

Documentation website:
<https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-eduvit/>

## Intended user and question

The app is designed for members of the public who want to understand
road safety across the state or in their local area. It helps answer one
question: **how have road crashes in Victoria changed since 2012, where
do most crashes happen, when are they most frequent, and which road
users are most vulnerable?**

## What the package includes

- cleaned data on every Victorian road crash that injured or killed at
  least one person, from 2012 to 2025, with local government area (LGA)
  boundaries and resident population;
- functions to filter crashes by date, summarise them by any variable
  and calculate rates per 100,000 residents;
- a Shiny app with two tabs: **Victoria**, for state-wide trends, times,
  road users and a map of LGAs; and **My area**, for crashes in one or
  more LGAs, including the location of each crash.

## Installation

The package requires R 4.1.0 or later. Install it from GitHub with:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ETC5523-2026/etc5523-assignment-4-eduvit")
```

## Launching the app

``` r

library(roadcrashVIC)
run_app()
```

The app opens in the browser or in the RStudio/Positron viewer. The
**About** tab of the app explains every control, definition and
limitation. All the data is included in the package; the background of
the maps is loaded from the internet, and without a connection the maps
show only the areas and the crashes.

## Data

- `vic_crashes`: crashes with at least one person injured or killed,
  2012 to 2025 ([Victorian road crash
  data](https://discover.data.vic.gov.au/dataset/victoria-road-crash-data),
  Department of Transport and Planning)
- `vic_lga`: LGA boundaries ([Vicmap
  Admin](https://discover.data.vic.gov.au/dataset/vicmap-admin-local-government-area-lga-polygon-aligned-to-property),
  Department of Transport and Planning)
- `vic_population`: resident population of each LGA, 2012 to 2025
  ([Regional
  population](https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/people/population/regional-population/2024-25),
  Australian Bureau of Statistics)

All sources are licensed under [CC BY
4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); the changes made are
listed on each help page, for example
[`?vic_crashes`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-eduvit/reference/vic_crashes.md).

## Generative AI declaration

I used Claude (Anthropic) during the development of this package to:

- plan the work tasks, after I had decided the intended user, the
  question, the data sources and the layout of the dashboard;
- point out compatibility issues between the data sources (LGA names,
  unincorporated areas) and write the code to solve them;
- check the correctness of the `roxygen2` documentation;
- fix many different issues in my versions of the UI and server code;
- design the two maps, with several styling adjustments;
- make titles, captions, headers and footers update with the selected
  inputs;
- convert the `ggplot2` charts into interactive Plotly charts;
- write the CSS that matches the app to my website, and fix the sidebar
  scrolling;
- draft this README, the vignette and the pkgdown site.

The question, the intended user, the choice of data, the structure of
the app, the design choices, the metrics and all written text were
drafted by the author. I reviewed every suggestion, tested every change
on my computer, and decided what to include in the final version of the
scripts.

# Package index

## Launch the app

- [`run_app()`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-eduvit/reference/run_app.md)
  : Launch the Victorian road crash dashboard

## Data

- [`vic_crashes`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-eduvit/reference/vic_crashes.md)
  : Victorian road crashes resulting in casualties, 2012 to 2025
- [`vic_lga`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-eduvit/reference/vic_lga.md)
  : Victorian local government area boundaries
- [`vic_population`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-eduvit/reference/vic_population.md)
  : Estimated resident population of Victorian local government areas

## Functions

- [`filter_crashes()`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-eduvit/reference/filter_crashes.md)
  : Filter crashes to a date range
- [`summarise_crashes()`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-eduvit/reference/summarise_crashes.md)
  : Summarise crashes and casualties by one or more variables
- [`crash_rates()`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-eduvit/reference/crash_rates.md)
  : Crash and casualty rates per 100,000 residents
- [`summarise_vulnerable()`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-eduvit/reference/summarise_vulnerable.md)
  : Summarise crashes involving vulnerable road users
